entries.title: Psalms 146:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 146:2
segments: While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

entries.title: Psalms 146:3
segments: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

entries.title: Psalms 146:4
segments: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.

entries.title: Psalms 146:5
segments: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:

entries.title: Psalms 146:6
segments: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 146:7
segments: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;

entries.title: Psalms 146:8
segments: Jehovah openeth [the eyes of] the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;

entries.title: Psalms 146:9
segments: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

entries.title: Psalms 146:10
segments: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.
